pairedFindings: Selective regularization removes the conspicuous isolated bright white outliers in both river and Ledge.
River ripple reflection shapes, bridge lines and boat fittings remain readable.
Ledge glass floor transmission, city geometry and reflected sill detail remain intact.
Fine low-sample grain remains; regularization is a biased variance reduction and is not a guarantee of physical equivalence.

convergenceMetrics.metric: Full-frame FFmpeg PSNR in encoded image components. Each16spp image compared against128spp reference with the SAME regularization mode. Measures convergence to that mode, not unbiased physical accuracy.

galleryFindings: All sixteen gallery images were actually opened and reviewed.
No new geometry obstructions, broken glass transmission, missing reflected detail or mast lighting regressions observed.
Night river retains warm reflected lights; tower masts retain continuous white illumination with red beacons.
Night interiors and shaded river surfaces retain visible fine grain at finite sample counts.
